digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler: outbound_comments, inbound_translate, port layer (FieldSanitizer, InboundMapper)
propositions: Core backend-neutral modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py) contain hardcoded lazy-load keys to Jira-specific adapters, violating port abstraction and causing vendor code to run for any backend.
Comment-body formatting and truncation on the outbound-diff path must route through FieldSanitizer.fit_comment instead of lazy-loading adapters.jira.comment_limits.

Inbound rich-text normalization (ADF decode) must route through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text instead of lazy-loading adapters.jira.adf, preserving the defense-in-depth that raw ADF dicts never reach EDIT event descriptions.
The outbound-comment ADF decode at _normalize_comment_body:134 must reuse the same InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text surface as the inbound apply path for consistent byte-identical decoding.

Public function _normalize_adf_body (re-exported by applier.py) must remain importable but delegate to the port layer; dead re-exports (_ADF_KEY_APPLIER, _AdfModule_Applier, _load_adf_module) are removed from applier.py.
A backend-neutrality gate verifies no package-root core module contains 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' except for the recorded inbound_fields.py exemption with documented rationale.
